notes.title: Alpha build 0.259
notes.content:
The new Alpha build 0.259 update is now live. Changes: 
1. Added a 3D effect to the 2D character images. 
2. A more unified font style has been implemented. 
3. Fixed a bug that prevented the no-weapon areas and walking speed from functioning properly.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Combat Feedback Improvements
notes.content:
We’ve implemented updates to improve combat clarity and enhance player experience.

[list]
[*] Damage Indicators:
 Players can now see the exact damage dealt to enemies. This real-time feedback will help you better assess the effectiveness of your attacks.

[*] Crosshair Feedback:
 Crosshair feedback has been added to improve combat responsiveness:
[/list]

notes.title: Update Note: Shields and Treasure Boxes
notes.content:
Prepare for a more thrilling adventure! This update introduces new gameplay mechanics that will change the way you tackle challenges in Timerift Raiders. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Shields Added: Gain an extra layer of protection against enemy attacks! Shields absorb damage, giving you a tactical edge in intense battles. Discover shields in hidden locations or earn them through combat victories.
[*] Treasure Boxes Unlocked: Hunt down treasure boxes scattered throughout the game world! These contain essential items like ammo, health packs, and weapon upgrades. Explore carefully—these treasures could turn the tide of battle!
[*] Bug Fixes: Addressed various issues, including enemy AI improvements and stability fixes for smoother gameplay.
[/list]
